components.users: Apex developers operate the factory; clients receive deployed apps in v1.
components.trigger: Architecture review before assignment; select first in-house proof.
components.metric: Measured generation/deployment evidence on the agreed proof workflow.
components.constraints: Proposal from 20 Oct direction. Decide supported Frappe baseline, generated-vs-handwritten boundary, fresh-install acceptance.

components.start:
1. Confirm the source scope and reuse boundary: SP-06/10/12/19/20; first in-house proof app.. Review overlaps before creating a new repository or service.

5. Exercise the critical failure case: Two fresh installs from the same lock produce equivalent apps; an unsupported baseline or missing component blocks generation.
6. Publish the exact artifact/config/schema versions, fixture manifest, independent QA report, integration evidence, operations notes and rollback procedure. Marjan reviews architecture/sequencing; Zyaad selects the security approver when required.
